Turn NFC on in Quick Settings or in your phone\'s settings so it can read your tag.
Some phones do not read NFC tags while the screen is locked. If nothing happens, unlock your phone and tap the tag again.

Hold the phone the way you will hold it in the morning, then press the button.
There is too little detail in this view. Is the lens covered or the room too dark? Try a spot with more going on, or use the flashlight.

string-array.name: mission_phrases_hard
string-array.item: Good morning! The coffee is brewing and the day has begun.
Rise up, Sleepyhead: the sun is over the hills already.
Take three deep breaths, stretch, and step into the light.
Now is a great time to begin; a tiny effort goes a long way.
Water, sunlight and a little movement make a bright morning.
Nobody ever regretted getting up; only staying in bed too long.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with one step out of bed.
The alarm has done its job. Now say Hello, world! and mean it.
Pour some tea, open the window and listen to the world wake up.
Today\'s list: wake up, drink water, smile, take one small step.
Great days start with great habits, so stand up and stretch.
Look outside, count to ten, and enjoy this quiet moment.
